info.title: Stremio NX
info.author: jrgf
info.details:
Stremio NX is an independent Nintendo Switch homebrew video player compatible with Stremio add-ons.

Features
Browse catalogs and play torrents or direct HTTP video links, including compatible debrid streams.
Select subtitles and audio tracks during playback.
Install and manage add-ons using manifest URLs, with phone-based setup for add-ons that require a browser.
Hardware-accelerated video decoding and read-ahead buffering for HTTP and torrent playback.
Controller and touch controls.
